title: Planting the Three Sisters Companion Garden Method
reason: Describes the three sisters planting technique and related processes.

tasks.task: Explain the three sisters planting technique and its underlying principles.

subtasks.text: Describe the role of beans in fixing nitrogen in the soil.
Explain how corn provides support for bean vines to climb.
Describe the function of squash in shading the ground.
Mention the Wampanoag method of the three sisters planting.

tasks.task: Provide instructions for building and planting the three sisters mound.

subtasks.text: Tell how to build the mound with specific dimensions.
Describe the spacing of the mounds and what to plant on the flat part.
Explain when to start the garden and what to do if transplanting corn.
Describe the planting of beans with an inoculant.
Describe the placement and spacing of squash seeds.
